'''Kostra''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] astronomical object situated in the [[Romintine sector/Legends|Romintine sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Attack on Kostra|attacked]] it, emerging victorious over [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|forces]] there. During the confrontation, the Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Fulkrehm Protial]] crash-landed on Kostra, where, due to exposure to the [[trosilon]] [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve gas]], he suffered damage to his motor control skills that the celestial body's natives were not able to fully heal.

==Description==
Kostra was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="CRO" /> located in the [[Kostra system/Legends|Kostra system]], a part of the [[Romintine sector/Legends|Romintine sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:FulkrehmProtial-CRO.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Fulkrehm Protial was injured as a result of crash-landing on Kostra.]]
At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Attack on Kostra|attacked]] Kostra<ref name="CRO" /> as part of its attempts to suppress the activities of its enemy during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the confrontation,<ref name="CRO" /> in which the Empire emerged victorious,<ref name="TEA" /> the Alliance [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Fulkrehm Protial]] was forced to crash-land on Kostra, where he was then exposed to a nearly [[Death/Legends|lethal]] amount of the Imperial [[trosilon]] [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve gas]].<ref name="CRO" />

Although Kostra's native inhabitants subsequently rescued Protial from the wreckage of his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and tended to his condition, they did not possess the necessary medical expertise to bring about a full recovery, and the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was left with irreparable damage to his motor control skills. At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] mentioned Kostra in an entry dedicated to Protial that was part of a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing various Rebel operatives.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kostra was created by [[Chuck Truett]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Kostra [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, in grid square Q-8.<ref name="TEA" />
